articleTitle: Predicting Results of Indian Premier League T-20 Matches using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Cricket, the most exciting and fascinating game that the people of all age group are very crazy to see and play. It is considered to be the most interesting and uncertain game. For many it becomes a billion dollar market as they speculate financially, hope of being able to earn profit. Every year the gambling market is going to be on hike as there is much great concern about spot fixing. In this paper, we have studied the problem of predicting the uncertainty of who will win the upcoming IPL match based on the individual competency of each player, coordination and team work of whole team evolving and technique followed by each team in each match. In this paper we propose a model using machine learning algorithms that can predict winning team based on past data available. We applied three machine learning algorithms namely Support Vector Machine, CTree and Naïve Bayes and achieved an accuracy of 95.96%, 97.98% and 98.99% respectively.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Multilingual Twitter Data using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The feelings of WEB users have a great influence on rest of the users, product sellers and market analysis. It is necessary to well structure the unstructured data from various social platforms for proper and meaningful analyses. For the classification of multilingual data, the analysis of feelings has recognized significant attention. This is called textual organization that may be used to classify state of mind or feelings expressed in different ways like: negative, positive, favorable, unfavorable, thumbs up, thumbs down, etc. in the field of Automatic Language Processing (NLP). To solve this kind of problem, sentiment analysis and deep learning techniques are two merging techniques. Because of machine learning ability, deep learning models are effectively used for this purpose. Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) and Naive Bayes algorithm are two popular deep learning architectures to analyze feelings in sentences. These architectures may be used in natural language processing. In this research article, we propose solutions to multilingual sentiment analysis problem by implementing algorithms and in order to contract the result, we compare precision factor to find the best solution for multilingual sentimental analysis.

articleTitle: Effect of Different Nano Meter Technology Based FPGA on Energy Efficient UART Design
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper, the main aim of authors is to design UART that is implemented on Xilinx ISE Design 14.1 and results were tested on Virtex-4 90nm FPGA, Virtex-5 65nm FPGA and Virtex-6 40nm FPGA. For 90nm FPGA, device used is Virtex-4, part name is xc4vfx12, package used is sf363, and it is working on -12 speed grade at an ambient temperature of 50.0 °C. For 65nm FPGA, device used is Virtex-5, part name-xc5vlx20t, package used is ff323, and it is working on -2 speed grade at an ambient temperature of 50.0 °C. For 40nm FPGA, device used is Virtex-6, part name is xc6vlx75t, package used is ff484, and it is working on -3 speed grade at an ambient temperature of 50.0 °C. In this paper, UART code is written in Verilog language and power is analyzed for 65nm, 90nm and 40nm technology based FPGA.

articleTitle: IOT based Smart Waste Bin to Track Dustbin and Public Complaint Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Internet or net of effects is concerned in every one parts of human life, work, health and social zones, which will importantly affect the prospect development of the worldwide financial society. Internet of Things (IoT) permits association among gadgets utilizing web with the capacity to accumulate and trade data. The net of objects refers to a kind of n/w to link everything with the net based on specific protocols during info sensing tools to perform info substitute & communications in order to complete smart recognitions, positioning, tracing, monitoring, and administration. Recent scientific advance have led to an increase in the carbon footprint. Energy efficiency in the IoT has been magnetize a lot of thought as of researchers & designers above the last pair of years, concrete the way for an emerging area called green IoT.

articleTitle: Towards Securing Real time data in IoMT Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the wide use of smart devices, smart phones, sensors and wireless technology, the Internet of things has changed the perspective of communication and handling of information over the Internet. The devices are used to measure health attributes, to automate the health therapies or to monitor and track real time health attributes. Since all the devices are connected to high speed Internet and smart-phones, people have started to monitor health attributes and medical needs through mobile applications. Such integration of smart devices, Internet and mobile applications results an emerging use of telemedicine and telehealth through Internet of Medical Things (IoMT).Security is concern as IoT application area is evolving vastly long with attacks on devices. Interconnected devices has many application in smart grid, health, military, computing area, daily day-today life like smart vehicle, home, security application etc. Intelligent nodes and platform are working together without human interference in them. Enormous security and privacy threads of IoT applications arise due to ubiquitous and dynamic nature of IoT. Protocols like 6LoWPAN, providing security on communication level that is machine-to-machine communication security through authentication and authorization to void the security attacks on network. To provide the security as communication level, to nullify the security breaches on network, proposed system provides the mutual authentication between M2M devices. Registration, authentication, and key establishment can be done for communication of M2M devices in 6LoWPAN.

articleTitle: Low Power UART Design Using Different Nanometer Technology Based FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In order to analyze the energy requirement of UART on different nanometer based technology FPGA, authors have designed a UART which is synthesized on Xilinx ISE Design 14.1 whose results were tested on 45nm FPGA, 90nm FPGA, and 65nm FPGA. The 45nm FPGA has device name Spartan-6, and its part name is xc6slx4, having package-tqg144 which runs on -3 speed grade having an ambient temperature of 25.0°C. The 90nm FPGA has device name Spartan-3, part name-xc3s50, package-pq208, and it runs on -5 speed grade at an ambient temperature of 25.0°C. And, finally the 65nm FPGA has device name Virtex-4, part name-xc4vfx12, package-sf363 running on -12 speed grade having ambient temperature of 50.0°C. Verilog hardware description language is used to design the UART. And power is analyzed for 45nm, 90nm, 65nm technology based FPGA using XPower Analyzer.

articleTitle: Study of the Attributes using Four Class Labels on KDD99 and NSL-KDD Datasets with Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: An effective dataset results in a smart intrusion inspection system. The paramount target of this field of examination is to acculturate about the contribution of attributes in KDD99 and NSL-KDD datasets. In this paper, divergent machine learning algorithms are employed with respect to four classes of attacks and their performances are compared for detecting the abnormalities present in the network traffic paradigms. The relationship between networks protocols with the attacks is also examined using data reduction techniques as an input to the selected classification algorithms for observing the performances of the algorithms on both the datasets. The study unfolds various facts about the network attacks and the protocols.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Band Octagonal Shape Patch Antenna For WLAN/WiMAX Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Due to rapid development in wireless communication for WLAN and WiMAX applications, many microstrip patch antenna with multiple bands characteristics with high gain are essential to design to achieve the desired wireless communication standards. The compact octagonal shape (Split Ring Resonator) based patch antenna with multiple band presented in this paper. The proposed design is implemented on FR-4 substrate with dimension of 30×26×0.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> which is cover the wireless local area network WLAN (2.4/5.2/5.8 GHz) and worldwide interoperability for microwave access WiMAX(3.5GHz) bands. The proposed antenna is simulated with results of S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>, gain, efficiency and radiation patterns. Patterns and gain are more stable over all the operating regions.

articleTitle: Ambient Light Monitoring System for Low Power and Lossy Networks Using RPL Routing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: An intelligent ambient lighting system has drawn a wide attention in recent years. Wireless Sensor networks for ambient monitoring is a multi-hop, self-organizing network with large number of sensor nodes. Ambient monitoring system based on The Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6) over Low-power Wireless Personal Area Network protocol (6LoWPAN) combined with wireless sensing technology can be a cost effective solution. In this paper, the performance of Routing Protocol for Low Power and Lossy Network (RPL) for ambient light monitoring application is analyzed in terms of Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR) and delay for both linear and random topologies. Cooja simulator in Contiki Operating System is utilized in the work. From the analysis, it is inferred that the performance of PDR is found to be better in random topology than in linear topology with delay as a tradeoff.

articleTitle: A Wide Band, Highly-Efficient Circular Patch Antenna with Split Triangular-Shape Slit
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: A miniaturized circular patch antenna with split triangular slit in the radiating patch is proposed. The radius of the patch is 23 mm and the ground plane size is 50 mm × 50 mm. The simulation is carried using CST Microwave studio software. The results show that the proposed antenna will resonate at 5.69 GHz frequency with extremely high return loss of 67.63 dB, and with a wide bandwidth of 575 MHz. The directivity is 6.372 dBi and the efficiency is 98.75 %. The proposed antenna has been successfully simulated, fabricated and tested. Good agreement between simulation results and experimental results is seen. This antenna will be useful in many Wi-Fi applications.

articleTitle: Virtual Machine Selection Strategy Based on Grey Wolf Optimizer in Cloud Environment: A Study
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In cloud computing environment there are many strategies used for virtual machine (VM) placement. Virtualization technology can create multiple virtual machines. The mapping method of virtual machines to physical machines is thought as virtual machine placement. Objectives for VM selection can be multi-objective and mono objective. MP's main aims are to reduce the make span time and speed. Cloud computing plays a vital role in content delivery services for processing data and scheduling the task like smart cities sensors data, healthcare data processing services (HDPS). Cloud computing for HDPS can restore patients' records, diseases diagnosing and different medical domains in less time and fewer of price. Here we proposed a methodology which is GWO algorithm based on nature inspired concepts. The algorithm will work on optimal selection of virtual machine.

articleTitle: An Analysis to Find the Efficient Clustering Algorithm for Identification of User Access Pattern
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: It is established fact that the out of data available on the internet much of it is unnecessary information which may be bug navigation requests, picture request, and incorrect demands. To avoid such situation the proposed logical data cleaning method is capable of cleaning irrelevant data by deducting from the web log records. We have applied four algorithm such as K-Means, Fuzzy C-Means, Divisive hierarchical clustering and Agglomerative hierarchical clustering on a dataset of “Educational Process Mining”, derived by the UCI Repository System for analyzing the distinct outcomes among them, Based on the co-relation coefficient that is Fuzzy silhouette index, Average silhouette width, Divisive coefficient and Agglomerative coefficient.

articleTitle: Modified Sierpinski Carpet Semi-Fractal CPW Feed antenna for wireless applications
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The microstrip antennas have played great role in modern wireless devices by reducing the size and cost. The proposed antenna is a planar monopole configuration modified with Sierpinski Carpet fractal. The fractals are applied upto iteration 2 of sierpinski carpet. The printed antenna finds its application in satellite and aircraft communication. The proposed antenna geometry covers multiple bands of frequency range 5.3 -6.558 GHz and 7.8-8.0 GHz. The parametric study of S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> VSWR in dB is discussed and results are encouraging. Design has been implemented for the given applications.

articleTitle: Optimization of Edges of an Image using Gravitational Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this work edges of image have been optimized using Gravitational Search Algorithm. Edge is an essential and extensive feature of an image. Edges of a picture are examined a form of imperative information that can be extricated by use of detectors with distinct techniques. Edge detection is a fundamental step as it is a process of selecting and locating continuity and acute discontinuities in a picture. Gravitational Search Algorithm is a prominent population based search method which is inspired by Newtonian gravity. In this paper, comprehensive analysis of edge detection using adaptive thresholding and gravitational search algorithm is used along with adaptive thresholding for edge detection has been performed. Experimental analysis are done on several test images by using these two methods which shows that edge detection using adaptive thresholding along with GSA optimization method has superior image quality and better Structural Similarity Index Metric (SSIM) value.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Anonymity Preservation in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Cloud computing is a new technology and modern concept of the world. Users store enormous amount of data on cloud storage for future use. Now a day's anonymity to the data stored in cloud is a feature and protection is a very major challenging mission in cloud computing. The objective of this paper is to provide the anonymity techniques algorithm for the cloud environment. We propose novel techniques such as, Tiered Blind and Anonymous Hierarchical Identity Based Encryption (TBAHIBE) and Spatial Keyword Search (SKS) for providing anonymity preservation to the data stored in cloud server. A spatial keyword search is a preservation that is optimized to database query and stored data in cloud ESHGR. This paper, presents the preceding analysis by considering the anonymity is provided for each data by using the TBAHIBE technique. We have designed a new anonymity algorithm for the cloud environment through an attempt to bring solutions of such problems.

articleTitle: SRR-Based Octagonal Ring Ultra Wideband Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper presents a compact and cost effective monopole Ultra Wide Band (UWB) antenna design for wireless communication systems being developed currently. The proposed antenna design has operating frequencies between 3.1GHz to 10.6GHz, which is being used for modern communication systems. The design has been tested and fabricated on 4.3 permittivity Forgotten Realms 4 (FR-4) substrate with a thickness of h=1.6 mm having trapezoidal shaped ground plane. Also splits rings are utilized in the regular 8-sided polygon to get better results. The proposed antenna with compact size of $22 \times 32 \times1.6$ mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> is tested and results are measured which shows close agreement with the simulated results. In overall UWB band antenna has steady radiation characteristics.

articleTitle: Load Balancing in Cloud Computing: A Survey on comparison of two algorithms PSO and SJF-MMBF
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Cloud computing provides us various services over the Internet and services have various problems includes security issues, energy efficiency, big data problem, load balancing etc. Proper Load balancing is used to accomplish proper resource utilization, optimal throughput achievement, reduce response time. Various research papers focused on various technique used to optimize response time, effectively lessens the system load, low computation and other overhead. Resources scheduling in virtual machine in cloud computing environment have also scheduling strategy constructed on genetic algorithm to reduce or avoids dynamic migration. The review paper specially focused on comparison of two algorithms PSO and SJF-MMBF on parameters like total flow time, completion time variance, RPD makespan, RPD total flow time etc.

articleTitle: RTT based Probabilistic Hop Count Packet Filtering at IaaS Virtual Cloud Infrastructure against CHCF and PHCF Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: HCF technique that is used to filter out the illegitimate packets from the total number of packets has got certain constraints related to detection rate of, malicious packets. The HCF technique never ensures us about the eradication of IP spoofed packets in correct and complete manner that has been applied at the victim server. Even the Time-To-Live parameters can be Spoofed or forged because of its limited values. There must be some solution for getting accurate values of number of illegitimate packets and almost up to its 100% detection rate. Hence, there comes kaleidoscopic view and lot of scope to enhance this constraint by maximizing the detection rate of malicious packets. VCPHCF-RTT improves the efficiency of the probability based Hop Count Filtering technique using Distributed HCF at virtual intermediate nodes and virtual server along with RTT. It lessens down the probability of guessing the RTT and HCF parameter values both at the virtual intermediate routers and at the virtual server by the attackers. The robustness of VCPHCF-RTT has been shown in this paper against CHCF and PHCF techniques.

Author Keywords: Virtual Cloud Probabilistic Hop Count Filtering (VCPHCF)

articleTitle: Embedded System for Automatic Transplanting of Vegetable Plug Seedling
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper introduces a micro-controller based automatic metering mechanism useful for transplanting of plug seedlings of various vegetables grown in pro-trays. The system is based for actuating stepper as well as dc motor connected to an Arduino micro-controller via UART protocol. We describe in detail the interlinking of different device in order to control the motion of stepper motor and dc motor with the help of drivers. The capabilities of the embedded system may be explored for its need based applications in agricultural industry and open future dimension in research. Our aim is to provide an automatic metering mechanism for transplanting of vegetable plug seedlings using embedded system in order to improve and automated vegetable transplanting operation.

articleTitle: Design Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antenna for GSM 900 and GSM 1800 Base Station
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this work the proposed antenna is designed to operate at GSM 900 and GSM1800 base station applications. The construction of the microstrip antenna consists of rectangular patch with rectangular slot putting at the top of the patch. The isolation layer that is used for this design is FR-4 substrate with relative permittivity (ε<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> = 4.3) and thickness is (1.6mm), conduction layer is copper with thickness is (0.035 mm). The effect of changing the parameters of the antenna and choose the best values has been studied by using the CST microwave studio suit version 2014. The proposed antenna operates from 0.94 GHz to 1.9 GHz and offers the gain from 2.11dB to 4dB, with acceptable antenna performances such as radiation patterns and gain.

articleTitle: Optimized method of Resettlement of Smart Bus based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Technology is evolving and giving new advancement for the welfare of human life. Internet of things is making human life easier and advance in terms of technology. As the Internet of Things is making human life so advance in the home, it can also be better utilized to make transport comfortable and time-saving. In the current scenario, the traveling, especially from public transport, has become a big concern. So the implementation of IoT in this field can easily solve this problem. In this paper we proposed a method where the public buses (local transport buses of the particular smart city) are equipped with devices which can monitor the overloading and under loading of the buses and if needed this information can be exchanged with the cloud so that necessary steps can be taken to provide a hazel free transport facility to the citizens of the city.

articleTitle: Data Interpretation for Social Network Using R API
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The exponential growth of Technology has altered the way of people expressing their views and sentiments aboutproducts and services they use. Social media has been forefront of this expression. Due to this a volume of data that gets generated. To find insights and make inferences we rely on agents that can collect social media data and represent in statistical forms. This paper explores and implements the collection of data and analyze it by visual representation in R platform. The approach is to focus on real-time analysis rather than historic data. Facebook API allow for collecting the sentiments information in the form of positive, negative or neutral sentiments. Social media package allows using different function. Through R platform for data analysis we can use Hadoop which on combining with R known as RHadoop, renders required functionality.

articleTitle: Secured use of USB over the Intranet with anonymous device Identification
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In the era of Information Technology (IT), IT basically refers to all forms of technology that involves electronic data in any form.It includes collection of data, storing it in proper format, processing it as well as circulation of Information. With the advancement in IT industry new peripheral devices have been evolved to store the data that can connect to a business computer terminal, especially via a USB port through devices such as Hard disk, Pen drives etc. Due to portability and accessibility, previously USB mass storage device/Pen Drive was preferred by individuals, enterprises as well as government but with the advancement of technology, there is a dark side of technology which is also increasing simultaneously in the last few years in the name of cybercrime. Various organizations have lost their sensitive or confidential information due to USB flash memory stick. Due to this, most of them banned the use of USB device. In this paper we present a solution to this data theft problem which will automatically fetch & store the Unique ID (Serial Number) of mass storage USB device/Pen drive and keep record in database to monitor registered user/device as well as anonymous device. We do recognize the patter of all connected anonymous device all over the intranet and represent it in a graphical form.

articleTitle: An Approach to Detection Probability of Cluster-Based CRN
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The performance of cognitive radio network (CRN) is directly linked with presence of primary user. The major challenges of cognitive radio networks (CRN) are sensing of primary user by secondary user and cooperation among secondary user. The sensing of primary user can be controlled through spectrum sensing capabilities of secondary user while cooperation between secondary user become more complex with increasing secondary user in CRN. In this paper we have study existing method for sensing primary user by secondary user. Combine cluster based network and energy detection sensing method proposed that improves cooperation among secondary user and inherently reduces overhead. The result shows reduction in access time and increase the probability detection for CRN.

articleTitle: Inversion of Complex Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this work inversion of complex neural network has been investigated by which Complex New Neuron Model is also achieved by extending the gradient descent inversion algorithm to complex domain. The performance of complex neural network in learning the function mapping in complex domain is also studied. The complex domain inversion of neural network and new neuron model has also been reviewed and investigated in this paper.

articleTitle: Automation and Control of LEBT Power Supplies using LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper proposes a design of LabVIEW based automation and control system for multiple programmable power supplies. Real time processing and communication is done by using LabJack data acquisition card, incorporated in power supplies. GUI has been designed in such a way that multiple power supplies are being controlled and monitored simultaneously.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of LDPC decoding by Bit flipping Algorithm using QAM and QPSK modulation techniques for DVB-S2
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Digital communication played important role in wireless system for development of human society for the efficient digital transmission, it is necessary to receive errorless data at receiver. Low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes are comparable with different coding techniques like convolution, block coding, BCH, trellis coding, turbo coding etc. in terms of performance and complexity. This paper presents more efficient modulation and demodulation techniques using QAM and QPSK for DVB-S2 (Digital Video Broadcasting Satellite) standard with LDPC encoder and decoder. BER performance of LDPC coding with Bit flipping Algorithm using QAM and QPSK modulation technique for DVB-S2 standard has been compared.

articleTitle: A Cluster-based Approach for Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Nowadays, in wireless communication, mobile users use fixed spectrum allocation (FSA) scheme, where a fixed spectrum band assigned to each mobile users for communication. Due to the FSA scheme, bandwidth crises happen in which mobile users cannot get the proper networks. The solution to avoid bandwidth crises is to use dynamic spectrum allocation (DSA) scheme. DSA is future wireless technology usages by mobile networks known as Cognitive Radios Networks (CRNs), in this paper, we have focused over the network performance by introducing the cluster-based approach, in which entire cognitive radio networks are divided into small-small sub-networks known as the cluster. Simulation results indicate that the cluster approach improves network performance in terms of throughput.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Importance of each Feature in Classification task
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In Machine Learning and statistics attribute/feature selection is used in predictive model construction. This help the Machine in interpreting the features easily by discovering good insight and improves efficiency in predictive modeling. The objective of our research is to improve the classification accuracy by knowing the most important feature from any given dataset. In this research, we used two techniques namely Data partition and K Fold, in evaluating the importance of each feature from the randomly generated dataset with 5399 instances and 20 attributes. In Data partitioning, the attribute with lowest accuracy is filtered out. Where as in K Fold cross validation, attributes with biggest error is removed from the original dataset. In our experiments, the evaluation parameters considered are Recall. Precision and F-Measure. Finally the accuracy rate of both the techniques are compared. The finding in our research stats that K Fold approach achieves better accuracy of 97.03% than Data partitioning(96.11%) in estimating the importance of features in classification.

articleTitle: A Novel Partial Protection Architecture to Enhance Reliability in Optical Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Optical access networks (OANs) have been favored as future access networks due to their capability to meet high bandwidth requirement of users. OANs have been deployed mainly as time division multiplexing based passive optical networks (TDM PON), such as Ethernet PON (EPON) and gigabit capable PON (GPON) and long-reach PON (LR-PON). These OANs are designed using optical devices, such as optical line terminal (OLT), passive splitter and combiners (PSCs), optical network units (ONUs), and using optical fiber. Some optical devices (viz. OLT and PSCs) and some part of optical fiber are shared by multiple users. Therefore, if any shared device and/or fiber fails, multiple users are simultaneously disconnected, partial protection architecture with reference to LR-PONs to enhance reliability in OANs by providing protection against failure of devices and optical fibers (links) with high failure impact factor. We show that proposed partial protection architecture improves availability of a network connection significantly. We also show that quality of service performance, such as average packet delay, average buffer size and average cycle time are preserved in the proposed partial protection architecture.

articleTitle: CLUE Based Load Balancing in Replicated Web Server
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: It has been seen that the number of users in (web server) are increasing every now and then. This results in bottleneck which may lead to crashing of web servers or reduces the quality of service. So, there is a need of efficient and robust algorithm for load balancing. We have proposed an algorithm that gives better result and is capable of balancing the load on data centre subjected to the key feature. As Load balancing is the critical task in the technical era and the traffic in the web is increasing exponentially, we propose a solution which deals with core load balancing to resolve this trending issue. Here we have designed an intelligent sensing algorithm that will help the server to distribute the load according to the availability of server, location and then redirect the request to comparatively most available server. Distribution of load is done according to the availability of the system instead of round robin fashion. Availability of a server is computed according to current trifle load, current critical load and a deviation value. Depending upon the computed load: the most available, available and least available server are found. Finally, the request is dispatched to the nearest server which is highly available.

articleTitle: Integrated Turbo Decoder for Validation of Baseband Data handling System
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The function of baseband data handling systems in the satellite is to encode and format the payload data suitable for the transmission on a noisy channel. For deep space missions the encoding technique to be used as per the guidelines of CCSDS is Turbo Coding for Eb/No of 0.7dB. Coding gain achieved at the ground stations using Turbo Codes is approximately 8 dB with BER of 10-6. This is better than 3dB compared to other codes. Thus turbo codes are preferred in deep space missions where power consumption at the satellite is critical (signal power is not being increased beyond a value due to implementation reasons). To test the data handling systems, payload simulator, acquisition and processing system is used. The processing system does the data decoding and de-formatting of the data to extract the actual space packets. This can be implemented either in hardware or software. The processing systems for data decoding used have multiple functionalities and are also expensive. The cost effective and user friendly solution is the software implementation of the turbo decoder. This paper presents the test system and its modules used for validating the data handling system. The paper emphasizes on Turbo decoder rate 1/2 implementation in C- code using SOVA algorithm.

articleTitle: A New Method of Bio-Medical Image Compression using Hybrid Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Image compression goal is to reduce the size of an image but without losing the information, the loss of information some time is acceptable but not always, today's world the compression of image, video done with various techniques for the variety of an application. Medical science is one of the main application area for the image compression in which we compress the human body part images without losing the information and use in future. In this paper we proposed a hybrid model for the Bio-medical image compression which is better in the terms of result by measuring performance evaluation parameters to improve the value of performance parameter.

articleTitle: Study and Comparison of Planar and Cylindrical Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper a cylindrical Patch antenna and a planar antenna are designed and compared and the effect of radius of curvature of non planar cylindrical patch antenna is studied. In this work, firstly a planar antenna is studied at 0.8728 GHz of frequency. At the same time at same frequency and with equivalent dimension, cylindrical patch antenna is studied. The proposed antennas are simulated using CST Electromagnetic simulation software and antenna parameters are also measured using vector network analyzer. The results show the variation of input impedance, radiation pattern, return loss of both the antennas with respect to substrate thickness, radius of curvature etc. The cylindrical antenna shows the degraded radiation pattern at the radius 29.72 mm of its ground plane, being the best optimized result. Due to curvature effect, the orientation of electric field will be different at the different angles, hence there are less chances of linear polarization for all electric field vectors due to which the electric field vectors gets scattered all over the surface. This is a serious short coming in the cylindrical antenna technology which itself is a major challenge. In advanced mobile system application (AMPS) and GSM application, this proposed antenna can be used as receiving antenna.

articleTitle: Audio Encryption Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The issue of security and privacy of data due to interception and improper manipulation by eavesdropper has a consequential effect based on the value of the information being transmitted. Many techniques are needed to protect the transmitted data which is in the form of text, image or even audio signals. Cryptography has a defining role in the field of network security. Various cryptographic algorithms have been designed, but still, there is a trade-off between security and performance. Our research work would be focusing on the performance of two existing encryption techniques such as AES and DES algorithm on the audio sample values obtained from the simulator MATLAB generated by the audio files of different size. Based on the results obtained this paper suggests the secure algorithm for audio file encryption and also to analyze the performance of other algorithms too as a factor of time taken. Through this paper we have proposed the model based on comparison of different size of audio files by taking into account of decimation factor through which the sample rate changes and we obtained a time taken to encrypt such generated audio files and thus we provide our analysis on AES and DES algorithm for the audio file encryption and suggesting which have better performance based on our results obtained.

articleTitle: A Sentiment analysis approach through deep learning for a movie review
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper presents a study of various learning algorithms using sentiment analysis of movie reviews. Presently, posting reviews on movies is one of the famous approaches for expressing evaluations and grievances in the direction of the box office collection success brought or viewer comments received. The growing importance of sentiment analysis coincides with the growth of social media along with critiques, forum discussions, blogs, micro-blogs, Twitter, and social networks. The field of the sentiment of evaluation is intently tied to natural language processing and text mining. Sentiment Analysis, which is likewise called opinion mining, is the sphere of having a look at which analyzes human beings' reviews as thoughts to understand if the character was “glad”, “unhappy”, “angry” and so on. The essential goal of this paper is to illustrate the research on deep learning model by using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with respect to supervised machine learning classifiers (Naïve Bayes, SVM, Logistic Regression, KNN and Ensemble Methods). The improvement in classification model accuracy through CNN classifier is presented as comparative analysis of their performance.

articleTitle: Challenges of Big Data to Big Data Mining with their Processing Framework
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Big data is an emerging trend and need of industries, sciences, and engineering area because all areas are having a lot of data and these data have given a result for a particular problem. This result is very helpful for taking a decision for growing to own area and this decision is taken by big data analysis and big data mining process. When any organization is performing big data mining process then it faces a lot of challenges and these challenges have given a lot of risks to take a decision. This paper presents big data and data mining concept with big data mining challenges which are related to data, process, and management. Data challenges are related to big data, Process challenges are related to data mining and Management challenges are related to the common factor of big data and data mining. In the last section, this paper proposed a conceptual big data mining process framework which is helpful for handling challenges and design big data mining algorithm.

articleTitle: The Effectiveness of Parameter Tuning on Ant Colony Optimization for Solving the Travelling Salesman Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Ant Colony Optimization(ACO) is a metaheuristic approach which tackles the combinatorial optimization problems such as Traveling Salesman Problem(TSP). ACO is highly motivated by the foraging behavior of ants and the way they utilize pheromone trail to discover the food source. The performance of an ACO algorithm is directy dependent on the choice of its parameters. The bad selection of parameters increases the computation time and accuracy of the algorithm. In this paper we studied the impact of the basic parameters that are used in ACO algorithms such as, α which is the relative importance of pheromone, β the relative importance of heuristics value and ρ the evaporation rate. We conducted an experiment for the better choice of the parameter values inorder to increase the effectiveness of algorithm for solving travelling salesman problem.

articleTitle: Challenges and Issues in Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Latest advancements in the field of Digital Technologies like Cloud Computing & Internet of Things continuously generating very large amount of data due to the implementation of newly invented information systems. Lots of efforts are required for extraction and analysis of this huge amount of data in order to make effective, efficient and accurate decision making. Thus, analysis in the field of big data created a very wide domain for research and development. In this paper, our objective is to get aware about impact of big data challenges, issues and tools deployed. By this paper we try to generate a platform for exploration of big data at several stages. Besides this it also led out certain issues which encourage researchers to provide solutions against the issues and challenges.

articleTitle: E-Health Services Composition and Adaptation Design of Automated Text Messaging for Healthy and Fitness clubs
publicationTitle: 2018 8th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Business, which does not have a website is missing out one of the most powerful marketing tools available to them. It is important for businesses to have a website by which people are likely to find you. To go online and research products and companies before they make a purchase. Considering this dependency on online, we develop a website for a gymnasium in which customer can get all information about the gymnasium and he/she can access or enrol at the gym via online. When the records are changed they need to update each and every excel file. The proposed system eliminates most of the limitations of the existing software. Increasing efficiency and effectiveness, automation, accuracy, user-friendly interface, information availability, communication capacity, maintenance, cost reduction makes our system smarter than the existing system. In our communication platform all the customer database will be maintained over a web based platform. Our communication platform synchronizes with Club Management System to support; sales, service, operations and retention with today's most popular & effective forms of communication. This platform helps in sending messages to a large number of people at a time. We have the ability to auto pull club data and automatically build you opt in text message database to automate customized text message solutions based on your business needs. The aim of this project is to automate the text messaging. In existing system the customers need to add the contacts to be sent in an excel sheet and upload it. The proposed system pulls data automatically from the customer database and sends text message at scheduled time.
